svg.title: Decision table as a threshold on the posterior
svg.desc: Repair is optimal when P(faulty | T) > 0.1. T = neg gives 0.027 (don't repair), T = pos gives 0.692 (repair). With cheap repair the threshold is 0.005.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: The policy is a threshold on p = P(faulty | T)
